stories.headline: 6 takeaways from Democrats' big midterm wave: Trump made it about him, and voters punished Republicans
stories.summary: Democrats took the House and Senate in a broader sweep than many expected, flipping seats deep in Trump country from Texas and Kansas to South Carolina and Maine. NPR's overnight analysis says the president wanted the midterms to be a referendum on him — and exit polls show it was, with about 62% disapproving of his job and a plurality citing the economy after the Iran war and higher gas prices. Corruption and a sense that Congress had not checked the White House also showed up. Trump quickly argued he was not on the ballot; the results will reshape oversight, the 2028 GOP primary, and how both parties read the map.

stories.headline: Trumbull election night: Lamont wins a third term, Himes holds the 4th, and Gadkar-Wilcox takes the 22nd Senate
stories.summary: Patch's Trumbull results wrap finds Democrats swept statewide Tuesday: Gov. Ned Lamont defeated Ryan Fazio for a third term, and all five U.S. House seats stayed Democratic, including Jim Himes in the 4th. Unofficial results also had Democrat Sujata Gadkar-Wilcox defeating Republican Scott Modlin in the 22nd Senate District, while Attorney General William Tong and the other constitutional officers won reelection. Local state House contests covering Trumbull districts were still being tallied as returns came in overnight.

stories.headline: iOS 27.3 beta brings Reachability to the iPhone Duo for one-handed use on the wide outer screen
stories.summary: Apple's first iOS 27.3 developer beta expands Reachability to the iPhone Duo after reviewers said the wide outer display was hard to use one-handed. On the closed Duo a short swipe from the left or right edge shifts that half of the screen toward your thumb — horizontal Reachability instead of the vertical drop used on other iPhones. The toggle lives in Settings → Accessibility → Touch → Reachability and is on by default. A public beta is expected soon, with the full release eyed for mid-December; the Fri Nov 6 MacBook Pro / OLED iPad mini / M6 iMac launch wave is still ahead.

stories.headline: Penguins waste a late 5-on-3 and fall 3-2 to Vegas for a third straight loss
stories.summary: Pittsburgh blew a chance to steal a point Tuesday at PPG Paints Arena, failing to score on a 1:22 two-man advantage late before Tomas Hertl's power-play winner with 32.8 seconds left sealed a 3-2 Golden Knights win. Tommy Novak and Rickard Rakell had put the Penguins ahead in the third after Hertl opened the scoring on a first-period power play. Arturs Silovs stopped 20 shots; the Penguins drop to 5-8-2 after the rematch with Vegas and head into another tough stretch on the schedule.

stories.headline: Breece Hall is 'good to go' and expected back for the Jets' Week 9 trip to Kansas City
stories.summary: NFL Network's Ian Rapoport says Jets running back Breece Hall (quad) is considered ready and is expected to play Sunday at the Chiefs after missing five straight games. Hall was limited in Week 8 practice while Braelon Allen averaged about 115 scrimmage yards a game in his place, including 147 rushing yards against the Raiders. Hall may not reclaim a full-workload RB1 role immediately as New York (2-6) tries to stop a skid at Arrowhead.

stories.headline: LEGO Ideas reveals a 5,363-piece $450 MonsterVerse Godzilla for Black Friday
stories.summary: LEGO officially unveiled Ideas set 21375 Godzilla — a 5,363-piece MonsterVerse build standing about 55–70 cm depending on pose — for Black Friday, Nov. 27, at $449.99 / £349.99. The figure gets articulated arms, a rebuildable head, detachable heat ray and signature dorsal plates, and early orders include exclusive GWP 40888 Godzilla Logo & Footprint. It follows LEGO's recent pattern of a big licensed Black Friday drop after last year's Enterprise.

stories.headline: Meshuggah books a 20-date 2027 European 'Forty-Year Anomaly' tour ending at Wembley
stories.summary: Swedish extreme-metal pioneers Meshuggah will mark their 40th anniversary with "The Forty-Year Anomaly," a 20-date European headline run in fall 2027 with Periphery and Vildhjarta. The itinerary hits major halls from Copenhagen and Berlin to Paris and Dublin and closes Oct. 30 at London's OVO Arena Wembley. The band framed the trek as a rare arena-scale celebration of a career built on polymetric riffs and dissonant heaviness since 1987.

stories.headline: Dave Grohl says jamming 'Highway to Hell' with AC/DC left him sobbing offstage
stories.summary: Foo Fighters' Dave Grohl told New Zealand's The Rock that filling in for The Pretty Reckless on AC/DC's Power Up tour led to a MetLife Stadium guest spot where he played "Highway to Hell" — then walked offstage "sobbing like a baby." He called it one of the most full-circle moments of his life and the loudest stage he has ever stood on, louder than Motörhead. Grohl traced the emotion to seeing the Let There Be Rock film as an 11-year-old and wanting to be "that guy."

stories.headline: Honda's supercharged V3R 900 E-Compressor edges closer to production at EICMA
stories.summary: Honda showed a production-leaning V3R 900 E-Compressor at EICMA with its wild electrically supercharged V3, titanium tank/exhaust bits and asymmetrical bodywork aimed at big-bike punch from smaller displacement. RideApart notes upgraded RoadSync connectivity with AI voice controls on top of the prototype's exotic hardware. Honda still has not published curb weight or confirmed how much of the show bike's chassis will reach dealers, but the project looks much closer to a real streetbike than earlier concepts.

stories.headline: 2027 Honda Africa Twin jumps to 1,131 cc with Dakar Enduro Sports and radar Adventure Sports
stories.summary: Honda's redesigned 2027 CRF1150L Africa Twin family debuted at EICMA with a shared 1,131 cc twin (claimed 117 hp), a lighter frame/swingarm and a lower fuel-tank center of gravity. The Enduro Sports model borrows CRF450 RALLY-derived front suspension for dirt work, while Adventure Sports adds a bigger tank, Skyhook Showa suspension and optional radar Honda SENSING RIDE adaptive cruise. The regular Africa Twin sits between those extremes as Honda tries to make the big ADV more capable without scarier mass.

stories.headline: Dodge confirms a 2027 NASCAR Cup return with Kaulig; new Charger Cup car unveils Dec. 4
stories.summary: Tim Kuniskis made Dodge's NASCAR Cup Series return for 2027 official at a SEMA preview, with Kaulig Racing as the anchor team after Ram's Truck Series comeback. The new Charger Cup car will be unveiled Dec. 4 at the Snowball Derby in Pensacola; Kaulig's 2027 drivers are due at Homestead. Dodge last raced Cup in 2012 when Brad Keselowski won the title — Kuniskis said the brand would rather learn "in real time" than spend three years planning.

stories.headline: Tesla drops a POV 'kickflip' video of the next Roadster barrel-rolling over its own lineup
stories.summary: Tesla posted a roughly 30-second point-of-view clip of the next-gen Roadster's autonomous McGregor demo, showing cold-gas thrusters lift the uncrewed prototype into a full barrel roll over a Model 3, Model Y, Cybercab, Cybertruck and Semi. The "kickflip" stunt — named by vehicle-engineering chief Lars Moravy — uses underbody suction and thrusters also planned for higher Thrust/Rocket trims. Production is still targeted around 2028 after years of delays.

stories.headline: Grok Bot can now call U.S. businesses for you — and early demos cut cable bills
stories.summary: Elon Musk urged users to try Grok Bot phone calls after the feature left preview and became available to U.S. users Tuesday. Demos show the agent navigating phone trees, declining upsells and summarizing live transcripts — one Comcast negotiation dropped a bill from $84 to $45 a month (~$500 a year), and another recovered a $100 Verizon gift card. Terms require the bot to identify as a virtual assistant; mass marketing and impersonation are banned, and some reps hang up once they realize it is AI.

stories.headline: NASA's 3,200-pound Swift Observatory is re-entering today after a failed rescue
stories.summary: The Neil Gehrels Swift Observatory, launched in 2004 to study gamma-ray bursts, was expected to re-enter around 3:30 a.m. ET Nov. 4 (with an 11-hour window). Most of the 3,200-pound satellite should burn up, but NASA puts the chance of surviving debris harming someone at about 1 in 2,100 between roughly 21°S and 21°N. A $30 million summer rescue attempt failed; Swift kept doing science afterward until it entered safe mode Oct. 20.

stories.headline: Kyiv hits emergency blackouts and water outages after Russia's biggest energy strike of the year
stories.summary: Mayor Vitali Klitschko said Kyiv and the surrounding oblast faced emergency power cuts and water disruptions Nov. 3 after Russia hit regional distribution facilities in its largest mass attack this year on Ukraine's grid. Ukrenergo ordered emergency shedding; trams and trolleybuses were suspended, warming centers opened, and several districts lost water pressure. The capital's outages follow overnight strikes on generation and substations across multiple oblasts as Russia renews its winter energy campaign.

stories.headline: New Haven man arrested in attempted carjacking shooting of a Yale employee
stories.summary: Police say 20-year-old Angel Rodriguez was arrested in connection with a late-October attempted carjacking on New Haven's Canner Street in which a 30-year-old Yale employee from East Haven was shot and taken to Yale New Haven Hospital. Rodriguez faces firearm, high-capacity magazine and drug charges, with assault and robbery warrants to follow. The shooting happened around 4 a.m. in the 300 block of Canner Street.

stories.headline: Two helicopters collide near Everest base camp, killing an Indian tourist
stories.summary: Two helicopters ferrying trekkers collided while trying to land at Pheriche (about 13,780 feet) just below Everest base camp, killing a 47-year-old tourist from India and injuring a New Zealand passenger and a Nepali pilot. Helicopters are the only way to evacuate sick or exhausted trekkers on the busy fall route from Lukla. The crash followed a hotel fire days earlier in nearby Dingboche as thousands of hikers moved after heavy snow.

stories.headline: Peak Design expands into Qi2 chargers, a slim 65W brick and lifetime-backed cables
stories.summary: Peak Design launched a travel-focused charging lineup: a 5,000 mAh Qi2.3 wireless kickstand battery, a fold-flat 2-in-1 Qi2 charging station, a half-inch Dual Slim 65W USB-C charger, and braided UltraStrand cables (60W or 240W/USB4). Founder Peter Dering pitched "fewer, better" everyday electronics against disposable bricks. Pieces start around $100 for the battery and station and carry Peak Design's lifetime guarantee (two-year battery performance).

stories.headline: Babylon Bee Guide: What to do if your side loses the election
stories.summary: The Bee offers its usual midterm coping kit for whoever woke up disappointed — a satirical checklist of "feel your feelings" moves that spoofs both panic and cope after a bruising Election Night. It lands the morning after Democrats' sweep as a palate cleanser between the results briefings.

stories.headline: Overnight repaving on Route 111 (Main Street) in Trumbull will start after the polls close on Election Day
stories.summary: The Connecticut Department of Transportation will mill and resurface a short stretch of Route 111 (Main Street) in Trumbull between Whalburn Avenue and Chestnut Hill Road, the town said Friday. To avoid traffic trouble on Election Day, crews from Waters Construction won't start until the polls close on Tuesday, Nov. 3, and will work overnight to finish on Wednesday, Nov. 4. Drivers should expect lane closures on that 0.09-mile segment, with traffic control personnel, signs and local police guiding motorists through the work zone. CTDOT says the schedule could change because of weather or other unforeseen conditions and asks drivers to keep their speed down in the area.
